Oliver (AE): Quick sync — NovaBio wants to close the POC today. Procurement insists on a PO-first flow and will only stamp if DPA + order form match their template. Need signer map and legal OK on redlines.
Nia (Sales Ops): Do we have the customers PO format? I have PO_NOTE_v1 and PO_NOTE_v2. They said they will provide PO number after we send DocuSign.
Oliver (AE): Procurement contact: po@novabio.health. They said PO will be "NB-PO-2026-77". Finance wants net30.
Harper (Legal): What redlines did they ask for? If it's only indemnity cap and eu residency we can accept via appendix. Anything around SCCs or broad audit rights will require exec approval.
Oliver (AE): Security emailed: "cap indemnity to contract value, data residency eu-west-1, KMS acceptable, HSM preferred but optional." No SCCs requested.
Ken (Solutions): If we promise regional residency with hosted private, SLA changes and Dedicated commit is required; pricing needs to be informed. HSM provisioning lead time ~5 business days.
Nia (Sales Ops): I can prepare envelope: procurement as signer 1 (stamp), exec as signer 2 (optional). Should we attach OF_v9_net30 + DPA_appendix_redline?
Harper (Legal): Attach OF_v9_net30 and DPA_appendix with these edits: cap indemnity to fees, KMS scoping clause, eu-residency statement, audit limited to remote with 7 days notice. For PO <= $150k procurement stamp allowed; above that exec signature required.
PayBot (billing-bot): Invoice draft: https://billing.redwood.internal/drafts/NB-PO-2026-77 (internal)
Oliver (AE): Customer procurement prefers stamp-only to speed. @Harper can you confirm that the appendix covers their asks so we can avoid exec?
Harper (Legal): Confirmed: for POCs <= $150k, appendix with those clauses is acceptable. Exec only needed if they push for higher indemnity or onsite audit.
Ken (Solutions): Pricing note: Dedicated/private + optional HSM = estimated +28% for initial month. Please advise pricing signoff.
Nia (Sales Ops): Envelope sent to procurement with PO field prefilled NB-PO-2026-77. ETA 12-24h. Tagging OLiver for follow-up.
Oliver (AE): I'll ping Procurement and the CISO. If procurement stamps, we'll proceed with invoice. :thumbsup:
PayBot (billing-bot): Reminder set: auto-send invoice when envelope completes.
Harper (Legal): Uploaded redline: https://redwood.atlassian.net/secure/attachment/55555/NovaBio_DPA_appendix.docx. Summary in comments.
Nia (Sales Ops): Noted. I'll escalate after 8h if no sign.
Oliver (AE): Closing actions: Nia to monitor DocuSign, Harper on standby for any countersigner requests, Ken to confirm final uplift for quote. Thanks team.
